cards.audioText: What types of aircraft damage can result from a poorly controlled landing in a strong crosswind?
cards.audioTextZh: 在强侧风中着陆控制不当可能对航空器造成哪些损伤？
cards.referenceText: A poorly controlled crosswind landing can place excessive side loads on the landing gear and damage tyres, wheels, or gear components. A hard or sideways touchdown may also damage the wing, engine nacelle, tail, or fuselage if any part strikes the runway. Severe loads can cause structural damage that requires a detailed inspection.
cards.referenceTextZh: 侧风着陆操纵不当会使起落架承受过大的侧向载荷，并损坏轮胎、机轮或起落架部件。重着陆或带侧滑接地还可能使机翼、发动机短舱、机尾或机身撞击跑道而受损。严重载荷可能造成需要详细检查的结构损伤。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you prepare for an approach when strong crosswinds are reported?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，接到强侧风报告后，你会如何为进近做准备？
cards.referenceText: Before the approach, I would brief the crosswind threat, check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured, I would delay the approach or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 进近前，我会对侧风威胁进行简令，检查相关飞机性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果无法确保安全，我会推迟进近或视情况改航。

cards.audioText: As captain, how would you manage an approach if you encountered stronger-than-expected crosswinds?
cards.audioTextZh: 作为机长，如果进近中遇到比预期更强的侧风，你会如何处置？
cards.referenceText: I would check the relevant aircraft performance, coordinate with the crew and ATC, and follow the checklist. If safety were not assured in the stronger crosswind, I would go around or divert as appropriate.
cards.referenceTextZh: 我会检查相关飞机性能，与机组及空中交通管制协调，并执行检查单。如果更强的侧风下无法确保安全，我会复飞或视情况改航。
